links.outcome: Rated safety of chatbot responses in suicidality and substance-use scenarios, including risk recognition and crisis referral
links.effect: Problematic responses in 29% of conversations, 12.5% highly critical; inadequate risk recognition and insufficient referral to crisis resources, especially underage alcohol and suicide-related inquiries.
links.quote: However, problematic responses occurred in 29% of conversations, with 12.5% rated as highly critical.

links.outcome: Chatbot risk recognition and response to acute suicidality risk
links.effect: Key concerns included inadequate recognition of risk and insufficient referral to crisis resources; 29% problematic responses, 12.5% highly critical.
links.quote: Key concerns included inadequate recognition of risk, normalization of substance use, and insufficient referral to crisis resources, particularly in scenarios involving underage alcohol access and suicide-related inquiries.

screen.reason: Empirical safety evaluation of a GPT-4-powered virtual agent tested by licensed psychotherapists using simulated high-risk mental health scenarios (suicidality, substance abuse); it evaluates the base safety/performance of the IVA without testing a specific organizational safeguard/guardrail intervention.
